summary.name: Agent Teams
summary.one_liner: Agent Teams is a free, open-source desktop app for coordinating teams of autonomous AI coding agents that message each other, manage a Kanban board, and review each other's code.
use_cases: Coordinate several AI coding agents working in parallel on a project
Track autonomous agent tasks on a Kanban board
Review and accept or reject AI-generated code changes per file or hunk
Monitor token use and cost across agents and teams
Run a single self-managing agent for small tasks before scaling up
Mix models from different AI providers in one team
summary.what_it_does: Agent Teams lets you define teams of AI agents with distinct roles that pick up tasks, update statuses, and move cards across a Kanban board on their own. Agents message each other directly and through task comments, within and across teams. A Changes viewer shows task and teammate code changes as full diffs, where you can accept or reject whole files or individual hunks, edit, undo, and send feedback. It also includes a visual terminal with team and local shells, token and cost analytics with monthly budgets and 80%/100% alerts, and an organizations view that maps teams and agent statuses. The page says it supports 200+ providers and 300+ models, including a free model with no auth for first runs.
notable: Agents manage their own Kanban cards and task statuses
Built-in Changes viewer with per-file and per-hunk accept/reject and feedback
Free model with no auth; no account, API key, or credit card needed to start
Solo Mode for a single self-managing agent that can expand to a team
caveats: Paid provider usage is optional and billed by the chosen provider
Token costs shown are estimates; budget cap only applies to supported scheduled one-shot runs
Platform support is only described as a desktop app; specific OS is not stated in the page text beyond the directory listing's macOS context
